ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God is described as Al-Samīʿ and Al-ʿAlīm?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse serves as a divine reassurance to the Prophet Muhammad amidst the skepticism of the Quraysh, affirming that God’s omniscience encompasses both the visible and hidden realms. Shia scholarship often highlights this as a precursor to the concept of divine justice, where God’s perfect knowledge ensures that no deed, however small, goes unrecorded or unjudged.
